caption: From a workspace list, the dataset's more-options menu holds Security, right alongside Manage permissions and Schedule refresh. Microsoft's own red box already marks the Security row.
A role with zero members enforces nothing — the DAX filter only applies to people or groups actually added here.
Once a role has at least one member, its options menu exposes Test as role — confirm the filter before trusting it in production.
The View as dialog banners exactly who's being impersonated, showing their effective permission and which roles actually apply.
